run_generalized_kmeans_1d: run generalized k-means clustering on 1D data with L2^(2n) distance and k-means++ initialization
run_kmeans_plusplus_initialization: run k-means++ initialization to select initial cluster centers from a torch tensor dataset
compute_centroids_newton: compute k-means centroids using Newton's method to minimize L2^(2n) distortion over multiple iterations
assign_clusters_to_centroids: assign data points to the nearest centroids using L2 distance with optional chunking support
update_centroids_from_clusters: update cluster centroids by recomputing means based on newly assigned cluster memberships
